D.unit: converts gross photosynthesis from µmol CO₂ m⁻² s⁻¹ to g CH₂O m⁻² d⁻¹

TRGH.source: tomgro_i.csv, 'all': transmissivity of the cover, Jones et al. 1999, spreadsheet (inferred)

states.w: g dry weight m⁻², above ground
states.wm: g dry weight m⁻², mature fruit

drivers.step: an hour; 24 rows a day, hour 0 first; no time zone

columns.rad: the hour's mean PPFD inside the greenhouse, µmol m⁻² s⁻¹
columns.co2: ppm; the model reads each day's first hour's

solver: a daily explicit Euler step; gross photosynthesis, maintenance respiration and the node rate summed over the day's 24 hours; the states updated in the order n, lai, wm, wf, w

compared.when: each day, from day 0 to the last

tolerances.rule: a value agrees when |ours - reference| <= absolute + relative * |reference|
